Short answers:

- Terms: we recommend 12‑month pilot pricing (discounted list) + option to convert to a 36‑month committed discount. Pricing in the term sheet is pro‑rata for mid‑term seat/usage increases; see tab "proration" in the XLSX.
- SLA: standard hosted SLA is 99.9%. For pilots under $50k we can include a 99.5% SLO with limited credit (up to 5% of monthly charges) as an exception — needs approval from Sales Ops and Finance.
- Approvals: Recommended sequencing below.

Recommended approval sequencing (fast path):
1) Procurement review (Northbridge) — present evidence pack + term sheet (this is your Tuesday meeting).
2) CFO signoff (finance) — typically quick for pilots < $50k; if your CFO wants protections, we can add a short cancellation window in the PO.
3) Legal review (optional for pilot) — we can limit to a standard Marketplace PO with Annex A (security evidence) to keep legal time down.
4) AWS Marketplace activation (Redwood seller ops) — we handle private offer activation once we receive the signed PO via DocuSign link.

I looped in Neha (cc) to confirm whether Sales Ops/Finance at Redwood can approve the 99.5% pilot SLA credit.

Next steps: If you confirm procurement will accept a short Annex rather than full terms, I will generate a DocuSign PO and a HubSpot deal update with the activation checklist.
